reasoning_content:
Composer install completed successfully. Now run drush site:install --existing-config. But first need to check settings.php symlink created by pre-start hook. Let's verify then run site install.

The command `ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config`. Let's run in background.

action.command: cd /workspace; ls -la web/sites/default/settings.php; su ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin && ddev drush status 2>&1 | head -30'
